articles.summary: On July 30, 2025, Governor Gavin Newsom signed Senate Bill 648, a law that strengthens California’s enforcement against tip theft. Beginning January 1, 2026, the state labor commissioner can investigate gratuity violations and issue citations and civil fines—a major shift that puts teeth behind long-standing rules in Labor Code § 351.
articles.title: California Cracks Down on Tip Theft: What SB 648 Means for Employers by January 1, 2026
